bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 12x12x12 inches are prohibited at Benchmark International Arena. Large bags must go through an x-ray scanner prior to entry.
bagPolicy.note: Medical and parenting bags exceeding the size limit are permitted but subject to additional search procedures.

parking.note: Parking is available at several garages and lots within a short walking distance to the arena. Payment is card-only, and purchasing parking in advance via ParkWhiz.com is recommended. The Pam Iorio Parking Garage is noted for ADA accessibility.

rideshare.note: Rideshare guests can be dropped off in our 15-minute circle located just east of the intersection of Morgan St. and Channelside Dr. prior to the event. There are rideshare pickup locations for after the event at the intersections of Jefferson St. and Eunice St., Nebraska Ave. and Eunice St., Nebraska Ave. and Cumberland Ave. and Water St. and Cumberland Ave.

concessions.note: Benchmark International Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including Asian-inspired dishes, classic American comfort foods, and authentic Mexican cuisine. Highlights include the Cigar City Brewing Taproom for craft beers and Corona Cove for tropical-themed eats.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Benchmark International Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Benchmark International Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Benchmark International Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Benchmark International Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
